messages:
Ava (growth): Heads up — webinar landing page goes live tomorrow 9:00am PT. Need a quick paid plan: keep lead velocity but avoid burn. Thinking soft frontload, then a midday throttle. @Priya @Marco can you recommend bids/creative cadence?

Priya (ads): +1. Plan I ran last quarter that worked: 20% higher bids first 3 hours, then apply a 0.6 bid multiplier rest of day and shift to retargeting at 1600 PT. Suggested CPC cap $6.50 initial.

Marco (creative): For search headlines I'll spin 3 variants: 1) "Join Redwood: Live demo + Q&A" 2) "Reduce LLM inference cost — Free webinar" 3) "Low-latency inference strategies — Live" We'll swap creative at +24h if CTR < 2.2%. Also build a short retargeting carousel for people who hit /pricing.

Priya (ads): Also recommend a narrow retarget pool: 0–7d site visitors, exclude converters, and a nurture pool for 7–30d with lower bids. Retarget CPM goal $12, CPA goal $45.

Jonas (analytics): Baselines: last webinar search CPL $38 (weekend), weekday $52. Impression share last time dropped at 10:30am PT because budget exhausted. If we want steady flow target daily budget $1.2k with pacing throttle to avoid midday spike. I'll set a monitor on predicted spend.

Katrina (ops): FYI — legal approved webinar creative and privacy copy. Need final UTM pattern before launch.

Marco (creative): UTM pattern suggestion (send to dev for final):
```
?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_apr&utm_content={adgroup}_{headline_variant}&utm_term={keyword}
```

Priya (ads): I'm going to deploy two search campaigns: "Webinar-Search-Frontload" and "Webinar-Search-Sustain". Frontload: $450 daily budget, max CPC $6.5, schedule 9:00–12:00 PT. Sustain: $600 daily, CPC cap $3.8 with 0.6 multiplier after 12:00. Retargeting: $150 daily (CPM), 0–7d pool.

LaunchBot: Campaigns queued: Webinar-Search-Frontload, Webinar-Search-Sustain, Webinar-Retarget-0-7d. Deploy ETA: 18m.

Ava (growth): Nice — Priya can you also add a flow fallback: if predicted spend >90% of daily by 11:30am, auto-pause frontload and move 30% to sustain?

Priya (ads): Yep. Will add rule: if projected_daily_spend >= 0.9 then pause frontload and shift budget to sustain (move amount = min(30% daily, remaining daily cap)). I'll post the rule after I add it.

Jonas (analytics): I'll wire a dashboard tile: predicted_spend_vs_budget + lead_rate by hour. Also adding a quality metric: % leads that opened confirmation email within 24h (proxy for fit).

Marco (creative): Quick refresh cadence for retarget carousel: rotate assets every 48h, but only if CTR drops >15% vs baseline. Will upload assets to shared drive now.

Ava (growth): Webinar narrative for ads: focus on "production-ready inference savings" + social proof line. Example copy: "See how teams cut inference cost by 3x — Live demo". Keep 2 CTAs: Register / Request trial.

Katrina (ops): Noted — I've added the two CTAs to the landing page. Confirming GA & GTM tags are present.

Priya (ads): Rule posted: `if projected_spend >= 0.9 => pause:Webinar-Search-Frontload, increase_budget:Webinar-Search-Sustain by X`. Implementing now. :gear:

LaunchBot: Campaigns deployed. Frontload budget $450/day, Sustain $600/day, Retarget $150/day. Monitoring enabled.

Jonas (analytics): First hour forecast looks good. Projected end-of-day spend ~78% of cap with current pacing.

Ava (growth): Perfect. Final checklist: (1) Priya — confirm rule + send screenshot (2) Marco — share final assets links (3) Jonas — invite link to dashboard. We'll reconvene 30m after launch for a quick read. :rocket:

Priya (ads): Screenshot posted in thread (uploaded). :thumbsup:

Marco (creative): Assets uploaded: drive.google.com/xxx (shared).

Jonas (analytics): Dashboard invite sent. See realtime tile.

Ava (growth): Thanks team — see you at 9:35am PT for live pulse.
